title: Protection warrior: never taunts a mob a second bot tank (Protection paladin) holds

rules.desc: The Protection warrior casts no Taunt, Mocking Blow or Challenging Shout on a mob whose current target is the second bot tank (extra1, a Protection paladin). Only casts 10 s or more into the fight and outside 8 s after a refill count: a fresh mob opens on the DPS player and both tanks may answer it in the same second
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:326-363 (LoseAggroTrigger: a tank target's victim that IsTank -> false); ai/playerbot/policy/combat/AttackerOfNonTankPolicy.h:34-38 (victimIsTank: no taunt needed); ai/playerbot/strategy/values/AttackerOfNonTankTargetValue.cpp:33-44 (the victim is read as a Player, bots included, and its IsTank decides); ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAI.cpp:4220-4241 (IsTank: a hire's tank strategy or forced role); ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:126-138 (lose aggro and party member attacked rows); TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649
rules.why_expect: once the paladin holds a mob its victim IsTank, so LoseAggro stays false (GenericTriggers.cpp:345-355) and the taunt-on-attacker pick drops it (AttackerOfNonTankPolicy.h:36). Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649; a FAIL with the precondition rule passing means the warrior taunts off another tank

rules.desc: Precondition: the second bot tank held a mob and took at least 5 hits from it, so a warrior that never meets a mob on the other tank cannot pass the rule above
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the mob's own hits on extra1 prove the paladin held it
rules.why_expect: a Protection paladin hire in the tank role taunts a mob that is on the DPS player (its own taunt rows at ACTION_MOVE) or wins it on threat; a repeat where it never holds one shows here instead of passing silently

rules.desc: Precondition: the Protection warrior casts on the mob at least 5 times in the fight, so an idle or dead bot cannot pass
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the bot's own casts prove it fought
rules.why_expect: a tank that fights casts every few seconds; a repeat with fewer casts shows here instead of passing silently

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
